card.name: The word out after a verb
card.fires_on: The particle "out" right after verbs like reach, fill, spread, break or even. A weaker second case is partway through words such as terabytes or occupationally.

modes.label: Verb + out
modes.description: The word "out" completes a phrasal verb such as reach out, fill out or spread out.

modes.label: Inside longer words
modes.description: The marked piece is the end of a long word such as terabytes or occupationally.
